name: deleting files on a drive whose quota is full still commits, and the files that do not fit are listed one by one
description: INFOMANIAK-006 (Infomaniak Swiss Backup, trigger a): with the quota full, old backups could not be deleted and no space was freed. Rules V7 and E4 of planning/sync-engine-v1.md: a full quota turns the drive read-only for new bytes, never for the owner's deletes; a file that does not fit is listed (quota-exceeded) and stays here untouched while the rest of the pass goes on. sync-chaos srv-s3-conformance (server side) and res-quota-exceeded.

name: the S3 gateway's own conformance (aws-chunked uploads, Duplicati, restic) is a server property
description: INFOMANIAK-006 (triggers b and c): the AWS CLI's aws-chunked uploads were refused and Duplicati got 502 on two clusters. Rule V1 is the S3 service's, proven by sync-chaos srv-s3-conformance in dc mode (azctl test e2e --only aws --only rclone, s3tests).
not_applicable: AzDrive's sync talks to its drive through the engine's own Drive interface, not through an S3 client; the gateway's aws-chunked, trailing-checksum and third-party-client conformance is the server's test (sync-chaos srv-s3-conformance, dc mode)

name: a device that joins with the recovery code alone reads every file, also after the drive key was rotated
description: INFOMANIAK-006 (trigger d): a lost restic/Acronis password made the encrypted backups unrecoverable and the key could not be changed. Rule I1 and the key vault: the drive key has a recovery wrap, a rotation keeps old files readable, and a new device opened from the recovery code alone decrypts everything. sync-chaos crypto-keys-and-recovery.
pending: drive_open {device, remote, key_from: "recovery"} (a device that joins with the drive's recovery code alone, not the shared in-memory keyring) and drive_rotate_key {remote} (rotate the drive key, old file keys rewrapped)
